thread:
mira: Escalation from customer — intermittent 401 then 500s and high tail latency. They see ~15s client timeouts. Need minimal repro scripts (curl, python, node, go) + exact request IDs and instructions to collect a debug bundle. Can SRE + SDK please advise? :pray:

alex: Pinging @jordan and @sam. Any quick hypotheses? Auth refresh errors or gateway instability?

jordan: On it. Two quick clarifying Qs: which SDK version and do we have full request IDs (not truncated)? Also want rough timestamps.

mira: SDK v0.9.4. Full req ids sent in PM — pasting here for triage: 01G7QH9R2X-req-9ab3ef, 01G7QHEK3L-req-f1c2d0, 01G7QHF13Z-req-c7e8a9. Pattern: initial 401, retry gives 500, next attempt 504.

sam: Thanks. For repro we need: a curl with X-Request-ID, small python/node/go snippets, and a note to run with --max-time to mimic customer timeouts. Jordan: can you craft the canonical short snippets we publish in the KB? Keep them minimal.

jordan: yep. Quick curl to reproduce auth+latency: 

```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
-H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_TOKEN"
-H "Content-Type: application/json"
-H "X-Request-ID: 01G7QH9R2X-req-9ab3ef"
-d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello","max_tokens":5}'
--connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15
```

Add `--retry 0` to observe the original 401 without retries.

alex: Also ask customer to enable debug headers and capture response headers (X-Trace-ID, X-Request-ID) and provide router logs if possible. If hosted, have them run with `RW_DEBUG=1` and attach /var/log/redwood/sdk.log.

mira: Jordan — can you paste the three tiny SDK snippets (python/node/go)? Keep them copy-paste ready.

jordan: Sure — minimal examples: 

Python:
```
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer "+TOKEN, "X-Request-ID":"01G7QH9R2X-req-9ab3ef"}
r = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", json={"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hi"}, headers=headers, timeout=15)
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```

Node (node-fetch):
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Request-ID': '01G7QHEK3L-req-f1c2d0', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-alpha', input: 'hi' }),
  timeout: 15000
})
```

Go (net/http):
```
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewReader([]byte(`{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hi"}`)))
req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+token)
req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID","01G7QHF13Z-req-c7e8a9")
client := http.Client{Timeout:15*time.Second}
resp, _ := client.Do(req)
```

sam: I'll run these from a VPC egress sim and check for router-side 5xx correlation. Also capture /var/log/redwood/router.log and packet traces if needed. If token refresh is implicated, auth-service logs should show 401s originating from refresh flow.

support-bot: Deploy alert: deploy/redwood-api v1.14.2 started at 2024-11-03T13:58:12Z — may overlap customer window.

alex: Good catch — if deploy overlapped their window we might see transient 5xxs. Ask customer to include the exact UTC timestamp when they saw the errors and to run the curl with `-H "X-Debug-Mode: 1"` so we return extra debug headers. Also request the `X-Trace-ID` response header for server-side correlation.

mira: I'll send all three snippets and the debug-bundle instructions to the customer. Request they run one snippet, attach the output, include system clock, region, and egress IP. Marking this escalation -> SRE P1 until we get the bundle.

jordan: one more: include a version that disables client retries (`--retry 0` or SDK retry disabled) so we can see the original failure.

mira: Added. Ticket updated and customer pinged with steps. Will post back when bundle uploaded. :email:
summary: Escalation thread to collect compact repro snippets (curl/python/node/go), request IDs, and debug bundle instructions for auth/latency/5xx issue. Includes deploy overlap note and steps to capture X-Trace-ID and logs.
